note: Registry of studio teams. NOT a Claude Code team definition (Agent Teams are created at runtime by the lead; .claude/teams is not read). Used by `studio.py teams` and the /studio-team command.

historical_research.mission: Establish what is known, disputed and unknown about the event with an auditable source register.
historical_research.why_this_mode: Bounded research questions fan out well as isolated subagents; no inter-agent debate needed.
historical_research.acceptance: All criteria of set historical_research PASS with evidence; fact-checker independently re-verified sources for core claims.
historical_research.spawn_prompt: Create an agent team for 'historical_research'. Spawn teammates using these agent types: historical-researcher, historical-fact-checker. Each teammate must first invoke the skills named in its agent definition (teammates do NOT get skills preloaded) and read the approved project files. Creators produce HISTORICAL_BIBLE.md; reviewers work independently and never edit creator files. Close every deliverable with the review-and-revision-loop (studio.py review open/close) and only report PASS with evidence. Do not approve gates; do not spend money.
historical_research.fallback: If Agent Teams are disabled (default), run the same roles as sequential/parallel subagents from the Executive Producer; creator and reviewer remain different agents.
